findings.evidence: `Polynomial.splits_iff_card_roots` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Splits.lean:373) gives `roots.card = natDegree = n`; `Fin.univ_val_map : Finset.univ.val.map f = List.ofFn f` (mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Fintype/Basic.lean:55) with `Multiset.toList`/`List.ofFn_get` turns a multiset of card `n` into the required `x`. Downstream Layer 4 statements (`Suggested.lean:585`, the Vieta step at `Suggested.lean:573-578`) take a root enumeration as a hypothesis, so producing one is the consumer's burden.
findings.fix: Add `theorem exists_isRootEnumeration (hdeg : f.natDegree = n) (h : (f.map (algebraMap F L)).Splits) : ∃ x : Fin n → L, IsRootEnumeration f x`, the converse of `IsRootEnumeration.splits`.
findings.issue: No introduction rule. The only ways to build an `IsRootEnumeration` are `isRootEnumeration_iff` (the raw multiset equation) and `Polynomial.Separable.isRootEnumeration`, which covers only the separable case. The docstring at line 52 advertises the definition precisely for polynomials with repeated roots, and in that case a consumer holding `(f.map (algebraMap F L)).Splits` has no way to obtain an enumeration.

findings.evidence: `Polynomial.mem_rootSet'` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Roots.lean:639) is `a ∈ p.rootSet S ↔ p.map (algebraMap T S) ≠ 0 ∧ aeval a p = 0`; the file provides no lemma between `mem_rootSet_iff` (line 92) and this.
findings.fix: Add `theorem aeval_eq_zero (hx : IsRootEnumeration f x) (i : Fin n) : aeval (x i) f = 0`, proved as `(Polynomial.mem_rootSet'.1 (hx.mem_rootSet_iff.2 ⟨i, rfl⟩)).2`; no `f ≠ 0` hypothesis is needed, since `Fin n` being inhabited already forces `f ≠ 0` through the enumeration.
findings.issue: Missing the primary elimination form: nothing states that each enumerated element is a root. `mem_roots_iff`/`mem_rootSet_iff` only give multiset/set membership, so every consumer that needs `aeval (x i) f = 0` (i.e. every resolvent evaluation) must peel `Polynomial.mem_rootSet'` by hand.

summary: The surface is minimal and correctly unexposed, with a `_iff` restatement instead of `@[expose]`, but the characteristic API is incomplete: there is no introduction rule producing an `IsRootEnumeration` from a splitting hypothesis (the repeated-root case the definition exists for), and no elimination giving that each `x i` is a root.
